description: Shows which kits makersmcp has and their versions, the Chrome and the ffmpeg found for them (and ffprobe while a kit that reads videos with it is on), any setting that leads to no program, and where files are saved. Use it when a tool is missing or a kit fails to start. Settings like CHROME_PATH, FFMPEG_PATH and MAKERSMCP_OUT go in this server's entry in the MCP client's settings, and take effect when the client starts it again.
name: check_setup
title: Check the setup
